pattern_text:
Diamond Lattice Relief Swatch
Version 1.0.0

Gauge: 12.5 sts x 13.8 rows = 10cm in sc, 5.0mm hook
Materials: worsted acrylic; worsted acrylic
Terminology: US terms

## panel
Foundation: ch 18.
Row 1 (cream): Ch 1, turn. sc in next 18 sts. (18 sts)
Row 2 (ink): Ch 1, turn. [sc in next 3 sts, dc in next 3 sts, sc in next 3 sts] x 2. (18 sts)
Row 3 (cream): Ch 1, turn. [sc in next 2 sts, dc in next 2 sts, sc in next st, dc in next 2 sts, sc in next 2 sts] x 2. (18 sts)
Row 4 (ink): Ch 1, turn. [sc in next st, dc in next 2 sts, sc in next 3 sts, dc in next 2 sts, sc in next st] x 2. (18 sts)
Row 5 (cream): Ch 1, turn. [dc in next 2 sts, sc in next 5 sts, dc in next 2 sts] x 2. (18 sts)
Row 6 (ink): Ch 1, turn. [sc in next st, dc in next 2 sts, sc in next 3 sts, dc in next 2 sts, sc in next st] x 2. (18 sts)
Row 7 (cream): Ch 1, turn. [sc in next 2 sts, dc in next 2 sts, sc in next st, dc in next 2 sts, sc in next 2 sts] x 2. (18 sts)
Row 8 (ink): Ch 1, turn. [sc in next 3 sts, dc in next 3 sts, sc in next 3 sts] x 2. (18 sts)
Row 9 (cream): Ch 1, turn. [sc in next 4 sts, dc in next st, sc in next 4 sts] x 2. (18 sts)
Row 10 (ink): Ch 1, turn. [sc in next 3 sts, dc in next 3 sts, sc in next 3 sts] x 2. (18 sts)
Row 11 (cream): Ch 1, turn. [sc in next 2 sts, dc in next 2 sts, sc in next st, dc in next 2 sts, sc in next 2 sts] x 2. (18 sts)
Row 12 (ink): Ch 1, turn. [sc in next st, dc in next 2 sts, sc in next 3 sts, dc in next 2 sts, sc in next st] x 2. (18 sts)
Row 13 (cream): Ch 1, turn. [dc in next 2 sts, sc in next 5 sts, dc in next 2 sts] x 2. (18 sts)
Row 14 (ink): Ch 1, turn. [sc in next st, dc in next 2 sts, sc in next 3 sts, dc in next 2 sts, sc in next st] x 2. (18 sts)
Row 15 (cream): Ch 1, turn. [sc in next 2 sts, dc in next 2 sts, sc in next st, dc in next 2 sts, sc in next 2 sts] x 2. (18 sts)
Row 16 (ink): Ch 1, turn. [sc in next 3 sts, dc in next 3 sts, sc in next 3 sts] x 2. (18 sts)


## Finishing
Fasten off and weave in all ends on the wrong side. Thread each end through at least 5 cm of stitches, then back through a few in the opposite direction, so it cannot work loose in wear or washing.
This pattern uses 2 colours, so there is an end to secure at every join and every change.
Colour changes: 14 of the 15 start at the edge opposite the resting colour, so it cannot be carried: cut it at the end of its row and rejoin it at the start of its next row, leaving a 10 cm tail. Ends to weave in: about 32.
Block the finished piece: pin it out damp, easing rather than stretching, and leave it to dry flat.
Check the ball band before blocking with heat or water. Fibres behave differently and yours is the one in your hands.
